CORRECTION (this revision): the seed's single 'meeting_room' cell (x:5.874-10, y:8.011-16.022) actually contains a real interior partition wall observed at pixel y=367/371 on 1f_view.png, forming a clean capped T-junction against the vertical corridor wall at pixel x=457 and running solid (no door break) to the east exterior wall at pixel x=603-611. This wall was confirmed by direct high-zoom inspection (crops [380,270,630,430] and [430,355,620,600]) showing both wall faces terminating flush with no gap or furniture outline, and by the exterior-wall pixel profile at x=600-630 showing a solid cross-band at y=356-381 interrupting the east window run. The room is therefore split into a small north storage/shelving room and a larger south meeting/dining room with two table settings, each reached by its own separate door from the shared corridor (D4 and D5, both already present in the seed, now correctly hosted to their respective new rooms).

Calibration for this revision's pixel reads used anchors (pixel y=296 -> world y=16.021948, the north_room south wall) and (pixel y=585 -> world y=8.010974, the office/meeting zone to dining/south_east zone boundary), consistent with the seed's own office_A/office_B boundary (13.086 world vs 13.056 computed here, 0.03m residual).
The T-junction partition pixel position (y=367-371, midpoint 369) converts to world y=13.998 under this calibration; used as the new shared boundary between meeting_room and storage_room.

O7 (single east window on the old meeting_room) was likewise split into O7a (storage_room) and O7b (meeting_room) because the exterior wall profile shows solid (non-window) grey bands at the same two wall junctions (pixel y=356-381 and y=558-612) interrupting the cyan window hatch; exact window pixel edges (310/356 and 381/558) were read visually from the crop and are less precise than the wall-junction dimension chain.

Between the corridor (x:4.125683-5.874317) and south_east_room (x:4.125683-10, y:0-8.010974), direct pixel inspection at pixel box [390,555,470,630] found NO wall ink at all spanning pixel x=402-457 at the y=8.01 zone boundary row: the corridor's east-side wall (pixel x=457) and the south_east_room's north wall both stop at this row without closing the gap. This suggests the corridor may be physically open to south_east_room there (no door, no wall) rather than fully separated as modeled. This revision leaves the corridor/south_east_room boundary as originally modeled (closed cells sharing an edge, per seed) because fixing it would reshape south-zone rooms outside this revision's assigned scope (the meeting_room/storage_room partition); it is recorded here as an unresolved discrepancy rather than silently corrected or ignored.
